references.text: The tribe of Levi was given no inheritance along with their brothers; the Lord is his inheritance, as the Lord your God said to him.

The Levitical priests, that is, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have no portion or inheritance among Israel. They shall live on the Lord's food offerings and his inheritance. They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the Lord is their inheritance.
To the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance. The Lord's food offerings, that is, the God of Israel's, are their inheritance, as he had said to them.
Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he had said to them.
The Levites received no share among them, for Joseph's sons made up two tribes. The Levites received no portion in the land.
Ezekiel confirms that the priests shall have no inheritance in Israel; the Lord himself is their inheritance.
The Lord is my allotted portion and my cup; you hold my lot in your hand. Boundaries have fallen for me in pleasant places; indeed, I have a beautiful inheritance.
Even though my flesh and my heart fail, God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
The Lord is my portion; I have said that I will keep your words.
The Lord is my portion," says my soul, "therefore I will hope in him."
